note: Route-graph ratchet baseline (no-new-rot ratchet). Each entry is the CURRENT reachable-first-party-module-count ceiling for a LOCKED FIXED_ROUTES route (the primary dev-perf 'first-party graph pressure' metric from scripts/route-graph.mjs). The gate fails when a tracked route's count grows BEYOND its ceiling and when the committed baseline raises any ceiling vs the base branch WITHOUT a matching absorb record. Counts are captured WITH the companion extension repos cloned pinned (exactly as CI does via clone-extensions) so they reproduce in CI. Regenerate with `node scripts/audit/route-graph-ratchet.mjs --write-baseline` after cloning the extensions — a ceiling should only ever be LOWERED as barrel imports are narrowed, and is never raised SILENTLY. A sanctioned raise must be ANNOTATED: a sibling `absorbs` record `route -> { from, to, reason, pr }` whose from/to exactly match the raise vs the base branch (from = the base ceiling, to = the new committed ceiling, reason = why the growth is accepted, pr = the PR carrying the absorbed change). The gate validates records strictly (malformed/stale/orphan records fail closed; a carried-forward record may not be deleted while its raised ceiling is kept) and prints a LOUD NOTICE line for every absorbed raise. The tracked route set is route-graph.mjs FIXED_ROUTES; change it there, then regenerate.

/sign-in.reason: cinatra#2093 (epic #2086 S6) setup-time provider choice: the setup wizard AI step stops reading a cached OpenAI connection boolean and reads the READINESS RECEIPT instead, so src/lib/setup-wizard.ts (statically reachable from all five locked routes via the app-shell setup redirect) now reaches setup-readiness-saga.ts and, behind it, llm-purpose-policy.ts — +2 first-party modules on every locked route. The raise cannot be narrowed: the receipt read IS the wizard-completeness signal (a valid receipt is the only honest answer to 'is the AI step done' once Anthropic setup involves a skill upload plus a native-skills probe), and the purpose policy is what lets the step state the OpenAI-only skill-matcher constraint honestly. A lazy import would NOT change the measured graph — scripts/route-graph.mjs follows dynamic import() — so deferring it would move runtime cost while pretending the graph shrank. The delta is STILL +2 after the F1/F2 review fixes (the credential-save failure state and the performable MCP-mode fix-forward): both were written into modules already on these graphs, so neither adds a module. Re-measured on this PR head rebased onto main after #2208, with the companion extensions cloned pinned; the #2208 records this raise supersedes are retired by --write-baseline per the gate's retire-on-re-raise rule.
